- `geometric_depth_auditor`: No grounding failures detected, meaning the necklace sits 'on' the mannequin reasonably well in 3D space.
- `perceptual_quality_auditor`: Found no global distortions (blur/noise), which contradicts the Router's local texture findings only in scale; the artifacts are local/micro, not global image degradation.
